sources_used: Vodafone Group plc FY21-FY25 Annual Reports + H126 results (https://investors.vodafone.com)
_ordering_rationale: Vodafone post-streamlining (cession Italie + Espagne + JV UK Three) : Germany Service Rev (KPI maitre, plus gros marché), Group Service Revenue Organic, Vodacom, Adj EBITDAaL, UK + Vantage Towers.

kpis.signal: Plus gros marché Vodafone (~40% CA EU). Pression TV cable (TV pay-per-tenant abandonné), rebond attendu FY26
kpis.description_fr: CA services Vodafone Allemagne (mobile + fixe + TV cable). Plus gros marché (~40% CA EU). Vent contraire TV cable post-réforme (interdiction nebenkostenprivileg), pricing FY26.
kpis.description_en: Vodafone Germany service revenue (mobile + fixed + cable TV). Largest market (~40% EU revenue). TV cable headwind post-reform (nebenkostenprivileg ban), FY26 pricing.

kpis.signal: Cible >4% groupe FY26, accélération Vodacom + UK + Other Markets compensant Allemagne
kpis.description_fr: Croissance organique CA services Vodafone groupe. Mesure leading de la dynamique opérationnelle, hors effets change et périmètre.
kpis.description_en: Vodafone group service revenue organic growth. Leading indicator of operational momentum, ex-FX and perimeter.

kpis.signal: Joyau Vodafone (~65% détenu, coté JSE), Afrique Sud + Egypte + Maroc + Vodacom Financial Services croissance forte
kpis.description_fr: CA services Vodacom Group (Vodafone ~65%, coté JSE). Afrique Sud + Egypte + Maroc + Vodacom Financial Services. Croissance double digit organique.
kpis.description_en: Vodacom Group service revenue (Vodafone ~65%, JSE-listed). South Africa + Egypt + Morocco + Vodacom Financial Services. Double-digit organic growth.

kpis.signal: Pic FY22, baisse post-cessions Italie + Espagne. Périmètre nettoyé FY25.
kpis.description_fr: EBITDAaL ajusté groupe Vodafone. Périmètre réduit post-cessions Italie (Swisscom) + Espagne (Zegona) + JV UK Three.
kpis.description_en: Vodafone adjusted EBITDAaL. Reduced perimeter post-divestitures Italy (Swisscom) + Spain (Zegona) + UK Three JV.

kpis.signal: JV avec Three UK approuvée déc 2024, leader UK mobile combiné fin 2025+
kpis.description_fr: CA services Vodafone UK. JV avec Three UK (CK Hutchison) approuvée déc 2024, leader UK mobile combiné fin 2025+.
kpis.description_en: Vodafone UK service revenue. JV with Three UK (CK Hutchison) approved Dec 2024, combined UK mobile leader end-2025+.

kpis.signal: Vente partielle Vantage Towers à KKR/GIP/Saudi PIF (2023), Vodafone reste minoritaire actif via Oak Holdings JV
kpis.description_fr: Participation Vodafone dans Vantage Towers via Oak Holdings JV (KKR/GIP/Saudi PIF). 81.7% pré-2023, 64% via JV depuis 2023.
kpis.description_en: Vodafone stake in Vantage Towers via Oak Holdings JV (KKR/GIP/Saudi PIF). 81.7% pre-2023, 64% via JV since 2023.

_notes: Vodafone FY se termine 31 mars. Sources : Annual Report FY21-FY25 + H126 results.
